industries.businessCenters.title: Robots for office buildings: cleaning, facades | PROFROBOT
industries.businessCenters.description: Cleaning robots for office buildings: daytime lobby and parking cleaning, facade washing, floor-to-floor delivery, front desk. We’ll check your building.
industries.businessCenters.name: Office buildings
industries.businessCenters.lead: Common areas of an office building are cleaned by day, with tenants around; cleaning depends on a contractor and on ever scarcer staff.
industries.businessCenters.lead2: Robots quietly clean lobbies and parking on schedule, wash the facade from a roof cable and carry documents and lunches between floors. We start by checking elevators, doors, water and Wi-Fi.
industries.businessCenters.hero.sectionL: Office building cross-section: what robots do on each level
industries.businessCenters.photo.alt: A compact robotic floor scrubber cleans an office building’s elevator lobby during the day as employees with laptops walk past
industries.businessCenters.heads.directi: What we automate on each level.
industries.businessCenters.problems.item: Common areas are busy all day. Cleaning runs during working hours and mustn’t disturb people: quiet, no puddles, no blocked walkways.
Over 80% of cleaning staff are foreign nationals, cleaning companies’ payroll has grown two- to threefold in five years, and demand for cleaning workers rose 31% in a year.
CORE.XP and DAKO Professional; Avito Rabota, H1 2026
There are no water fill and drain points for docking stations, elevators can’t take a robot’s call, and people open doors by hand.
What a building needs, per developer MR Group’s automated cleaning standard
Glass cleaning is work at height: certifications, a permit-to-work, and no work in exposed spots when wind reaches 15 m/s. Every cleaning means a contractor with rope access technicians.
Work-at-height safety rules, Russian Ministry of Labour Order No. 782n
industries.businessCenters.directions.le: Four areas for four levels of the building. You can start with any of them; most clients start with cleaning common areas.
industries.businessCenters.directions.it: Robotic scrubbers and vacuums clean lobbies, elevator lobbies and corridors by day, with people around, and at night. Large driverless machines handle parking.
Developer MR Group: parking robots, up to 1,800 m²/h

The K3 robot descends from the roof on a cable and cleans continuous glazing while people stay on the roof. It can’t clear horizontal frames over 10 mm, so we check the facade’s suitability during the assessment.
Up to 1,500 m² per shift according to the manufacturer; pays back from ≈36,000 m² cleaned a year, our calculation at a contractor price of RUB 60/m²
Mail, documents and food-court lunches between floors. The delivery robot calls the elevator itself, if it is connected, and brings the order to the office door.
We found no Russian office case studies with published figures, so we propose a pilot on one route
A service or humanoid robot greets tenants’ visitors, shows the way to the elevators and answers routine questions.
Receptionist robots already work in Moscow companies
industries.businessCenters.ready.title: A robot-ready building.
industries.businessCenters.ready.lead: Developer MR Group has introduced an automated cleaning standard: it prepares its buildings for robots from the outset. Tick what you already have.
industries.businessCenters.ready.lifts.w: The robot calls the elevator itself and rides between floors and to parking.
industries.businessCenters.ready.lifts.n: The robot works on one floor; people move it between floors.
industries.businessCenters.ready.doors.w: Doors on the route open and close without staff nearby.
industries.businessCenters.ready.doors.n: We plan the route through zones without doors, or open doors to the cleaning schedule.
industries.businessCenters.ready.dock.wh: Space for a docking station with a power outlet, away from foot traffic.
industries.businessCenters.ready.dock.no: We find a spot during the assessment: it sets the route length and charging time.
industries.businessCenters.ready.water.w: Water fill and drain for the scrubber robot close to its route.
industries.businessCenters.ready.water.n: We use a robot with a mobile tank: it works without water fill and drain points.
industries.businessCenters.ready.wifi.wh: Tasks, maps and reports get through without dropouts, including in elevators and parking.
industries.businessCenters.ready.wifi.no: We measure coverage along the route and add access points where the signal drops.
industries.businessCenters.ready.verdict: Tick the items in the list and we’ll show you where to start. A robot can work in an unprepared building too, just in fewer zones.
industries.businessCenters.case.title: Robots already clean offices by day.
industries.businessCenters.case.lead: Developers themselves publish these figures; there are no independent measurements yet.
industries.businessCenters.case.mr.title: Robots clean towers in Moscow City.
industries.businessCenters.case.mr.text: Pudu robots clean the lobbies and common areas of the iCITY towers; separate machines clean the parking. The robots cost RUB 2–4 million. MR Group has also issued an automated cleaning standard for its buildings.
industries.businessCenters.case.mr.claim: lower cleaning costs, as claimed by the developer
industries.businessCenters.case.risks.te: The Pudu CC1 stops when people are nearby, visitors press the emergency stop button, and you can’t do without an operator. The operations director of MD Facility Management: “It’s premature to say robots will soon replace people.” That’s why we plan for an operator and a route that accounts for foot traffic.

industries.businessCenters.vendorsLead: We choose equipment by building level and floor type, with no tie to a single vendor.
industries.businessCenters.why.title: One contractor for the building.
industries.businessCenters.why.text: We choose equipment for every level, from parking to facade, deploy it and service it under SLA. You can rent the robots instead of tying up capital in equipment.
industries.businessCenters.form.title: We’ll check your building for robots.
industries.businessCenters.form.lead: We’ll walk the route from parking to roof, check elevators, doors, water and Wi-Fi, and tell you which zone to start with.
